components.name: Primary Start Action
components.description: Full-width teal action: starts the demo (rotating to landscape first) or toggles Ready online.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #164F52; color: #D8FDD4; font: 600 17px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; }

components.name: Robot Color Tile
components.description: One of eight robot tiles in a four-column grid; the selected tile is lime with a teal border.
components.css: .ds-color-tile { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 74px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(22,79,82,0.16); background: rgba(216,253,212,0.7); color: #30021F; font: 600 11px/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-selected { background: #D5E8A0; border: 2px solid #164F52; } .ds-robot { width: 44px; height: 30px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--body); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 7px var(--body), inset 6px 0 0 9px #0E2A2C; }

components.name: Section Card
components.description: The light panel under every lobby section: mode bar, setup, room status, roster and rules.
components.html:
Robot color

The first player to pick a color gets it.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(216,253,212,0.94); border: 1px solid rgba(22,79,82,0.16); color: #30021F; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3D896D; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(22,79,82,0.82); }

components.name: Standings Chip
components.description: Rank, robot and short name in the race HUD; the local chip is lime, crashed robots are struck through.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(216,253,212,0.94); color: #30021F; font: 700 11px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-chip i { width: 16px; height: 14px; border-radius: 5px; } .ds-local { background: #D5E8A0; } .ds-out { opacity: 0.6; text-decoration: line-through; }

components.name: Result Panel
components.description: Centered mint panel over a plum scrim with the outcome, the standings table and actions (race again / rematch, watch, change setup, back).
components.css: .ds-overlay { width: min(100%, 440px); box-sizing: border-box; padding: 20px; display: grid; gap: 12px; border-radius: 20px; background: #D8FDD4; border: 1px solid rgba(22,79,82,0.3); color: #30021F; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-overlay button { min-height: 56px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #164F52; color: #D8FDD4; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Faus Switch is a landscape gravity race inside FausCrew. Robots — the player against bots in demo, or housemates online — run the same scrolling course; a tap on a surface flips gravity between floor and ceiling. The course sits on a pale, grainy mint texture and every play object is dark, so it reads at a glance. The lobby is portrait and native; the race owns the landscape screen with only pause or leave and a small standings strip.
keyCharacteristics: One light textured background, dark robots and obstacles.
A robot runner modelled on the supplied reference, in eight selectable colors.
Obstacle groups of two or three that split the screen into passages.
Demo and online modes chosen in a portrait lobby; landscape race.
A minimal HUD without a progress bar or flip counter.
Native iOS type, controls and accessibility; Reduce Motion stops parallax and flip animation.

rules.name: Light Field, Dark Pieces
rules.body: The background is always the lightest thing on screen; anything a player reacts to is darker than the texture behind it.

rules.name: Berry Means Danger
rules.body: Only lasers, crash results and destructive actions use Hazard Berry.

rules.name: The Native Scale Rule
rules.body: Interface copy stays in SwiftUI so localization and Dynamic Type work; only course geometry is drawn in SpriteKit.

rules.name: The Course-First Rule
rules.body: During the race the HUD only pauses or leaves and shows standings; no progress bar, no flip counter.

rules.name: Split Passages
rules.body: Obstacles come in groups of two or three that leave at least one reachable opening; never a single column only from the top or only from the bottom.

dos: Do keep the whole playfield as the tap target; HUD decoration never captures touches.
Do keep obstacle groups split into passages and every play object darker than the texture.
Do show standings as small chips with robot color.
Do start the race only in a landscape layout and return to portrait when it closes.
Do keep 44-point minimum controls, semantic labels and Dynamic Type on all SwiftUI copy.
donts: Don't add a Start–Finish progress bar or a flip counter.
Don't use a dark night background or neon glow on panels.
Don't use Hazard Berry for anything but danger.
Don't let a mid-air tap flip gravity.
Don't copy the reference game's name, artwork or assets.
